lines.text: Maya starts down the Bright Angel Trail.
Downhill feels easy, so she keeps going past the point she planned.
Then she turns around, and the whole canyon is above her.
At the Grand Canyon, the climb back out is the hard part.
Here's the fix. Pick your turnaround point at the rim, like the 1.5 Mile Resthouse,
and turn there while you still feel fresh.
Maya climbs out before dark, smiling.
Save this before your canyon trip.
